reason: Editor documents preserve authored whitespace, attachment identity and ownership across draft restoration and sent-message editing.

codeKeys.reason: Code editing keeps modified newlines in the block, indents complete selected lines, and navigates at explicit block boundaries without stealing ordinary submission.

drop.destination: Insert at the pointer coordinates, leaving unrelated selected destination content intact.
drop.copy: Keep the source and give each colliding copied quote an independent occurrence ID.
drop.move: Delete the source once and preserve quote occurrence identity.
drop.metadata: Preserve authored structure, marks and full quote data.
drop.history: Undo and redo one drop as one operation, retaining the generated occurrence ID.
drop.files: Delegate file transfers to attachment ingestion before parsing companion URI, text or HTML.

submittedDocument.reason: Persist authored structure with each user message so formatting and literal punctuation remain distinct through optimistic display, history replay and editing.
